secrets.name: FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase web app config: apiKey (Firebase console > Project settings > Your apps > Web app). Also accepted via Firebase config env upload.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_FIRESTORE_DATABASE_ID
secrets.description: Optional: named Firestore database id. Leave empty to use (default).

secrets.name: FIREBASE_ADMIN_SDK_JSON
secrets.description: Full contents of a Firebase service account key JSON (Firebase console > Project settings > Service accounts > Generate new private key). Enables the admin/service API routes and admin custom claims.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for the AI concierge (console.groq.com/keys).
